title: WCPFC Public Domain Catch and Effort Data
description: Aggregated tuna catch and effort data for the Western and Central Pacific Ocean, published by the Western and Central Pacific Fisheries Commission.
notes: Core regional tuna dataset. Release is governed by WCPFC's Rules for Public Domain Data (aggregation and attribution conditions), so commercial reuse needs human sign-off. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: SPC Oceanic Fisheries Programme — Tuna Fishery Yearbook and Stock Assessments
description: SPC Oceanic Fisheries Programme statistics and stock assessment outputs for skipjack, yellowfin, bigeye and albacore.
notes: Primary scientific provider for WCPO tuna. No explicit reuse licence identified for the data products. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: FFA Tuna Economic and Development Indicators
description: Pacific Islands Forum Fisheries Agency indicators on tuna catch value, licence revenue, employment and onshore processing for member states.
notes: Economic dimension of the fishery that SPC catch data lacks. Reuse rights not explicitly stated. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: SPC FAME Coastal Fisheries Data
description: SPC Fisheries, Aquaculture and Marine Ecosystems division coastal and reef fisheries monitoring data and reports.
notes: Coastal fisheries are the food-security half of Pacific fisheries. Check any community-sourced survey data for customary-rights content (would be EXCLUDED). URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: FAO Global Fishery and Aquaculture Production Statistics — Pacific Members
description: FAO FishStat capture and aquaculture production series, filtered to Pacific Island member countries.
notes: Global baseline for cross-checking regional series. FAO database terms of use apply; licence not confirmed for commercial resale, so left UNKNOWN. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.
